title: Scheme-test presentation of a line module and its graded Proj input
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ with its small-etale category of modules [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $L$ a line module on $X$. A cartesian scheme-test realization of $L$ consists, for every scheme $W$ over $S$ and map $a:h_W\to X$, of an invertible $\mathcal O_W$-module $L_a$ [def-sc-invertible-module], with specified isomorphisms $j^*L_a\simeq L_{a\circ h_j}$ for every scheme-test map $j$, using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. These isomorphisms satisfy the identity and composition equations as sheaf isomorphisms. On every small-etale test $W\to X$, identify $\Gamma(W,L_a)$ with $L(W)$ linearly over regular functions and compatibly with every small-etale restriction. Such realizations exist and are determined up to the unique cartesian isomorphism preserving these identifications; use this universal property to denote the family of scheme pullbacks of $L$.

Let $T$ be a scheme over $S$, $f:X\to T$, and $\mathcal A$ the quasi-coherent graded algebra input of relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj]. A graded map into the tensor powers of $L$ is presented by the additive maps $\mathcal A_n(V)\to\Gamma(W,L_a^{\otimes n})$ for every affine open $V\subseteq T$ containing the image of the test $W\to X\to T$. They are linear for the structure map $\mathcal O_T(V)\to\mathcal O_W(W)$, preserve the degree-zero unit and homogeneous multiplication, and commute with every test-scheme pullback and every affine base restriction. This is the adjoint description of $f^*\mathcal A\to\bigoplus_{n\geq0}L^{\otimes n}$. Its generation set on $W$ is the union of open neighbourhoods where the image of some positive-degree homogeneous section is a free generator. A subfunctor is its generation open when a scheme test factors through it exactly when this generation set is all of $W$.

The canonical map from a generation open to relative Proj is specified over $T$ and, on every globally trivializing scheme test above an affine base chart, by the usual homogeneous-section construction into Proj followed by the relative-Proj chart embedding. A trivialization specifies the ring map by its value on every homogeneous element, and the usual construction is used wherever the image of the irrelevant ideal is the unit ideal. For a base-change identification [lemma-nagata-relative-proj-base-change-arbitrary], the pulled-back graded map is specified by equality of all homogeneous images after the coefficientwise base-change maps.

from.place: The scheme-test tensor pullbacks, graded maps, generation open and chart characterization used to state the line-module relative-Proj map.

lean.statement: structure GradedLineMap {F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {T : Over S} (f : F ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (A : T.left.GradedAlgebraData) (L : TestLineFamily F)
lean.note: The arbitrary scheme pullbacks are selected only from the stated descent universal property, which determines them up to the unique cartesian isomorphism preserving the given small-etale line module. The input is not an arbitrary family of line modules. Existing generic tensor-power comparisons from SquareZeroTensorBoundaryComparisons are reused without copying their definitions.
